target: IDMan.exe 6.43 build 18, addendum: suppress the trial nag HTML window
notes: Apply this manifest to the output of 6.43b18.json, not to the pristine file.
The nag window is the HTML resource type 23 id 113 page ('You have %d days left').
It is shown by a worker thread whose procedure starts at file 0x73A10 (RVA 0x74610).
The function is a cdecl thread procedure (its own epilogue is a bare ret), so a bare ret stub keeps the stack balanced.
Overwriting 55 8B EC with 31 C0 C3 makes the thread return 0 before it builds the dialog.
The checksum field at file 0x150 is recomputed by the patcher and is not listed as a patch.
